== Biography ==
'''Mary Glasgow''' was born on 13 Apr 1745 and baptised at Irvine, Ayrshire, on 21 Apr 1745. The parish register names her father as [[Glasgow-4165|George Glasgow]] and her mother as Margt. in the held derivative; companion transcripts name Margaret Martine.<ref name="FMP1" /> The register records both dates; Irvine is inferred from the baptism and is not independently recorded.

Mary Glasgow was one of the children recorded to George Glasgow in the Irvine register, alongside [[Glasgow-4121|Isabel]] (1741), [[Glasgow-4103|Magdalen]] (1743).


The two companion Findmypast entries for her 21 April 1745 Irvine baptism name George Glasgow and Margaret Martine. The already held OPR derivative names the mother Margt and gives birth 13 April 1745. These are three derivatives of one event.<ref>[https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=R_685313886&tab=this Findmypast R_685313886], inspected derivative transcript, 25 October 2026; original uninspected.</ref><ref>[https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=R_688620486&tab=this Findmypast R_688620486], inspected derivative transcript, 25 October 2026; original uninspected.</ref>
